speaker: a010
text: Roan gathers Eron, Fina to talk.

speaker: a010
text: Eron, Fina — Dell is dead and the pile is already moving out there, and I want the two of you to hear me before anyone else gets their words in: take what you need from that pile today, don't hold back on my account, because I've got twelve in hand and I'd rather count short than bury another name I love.

speaker: a015
text: Roan, I've got eight and satiation's still at two, so I'm taking two from that pile before it walks away — but what I want to say to you and Eron while we're alone is that Dell fed Ryn through every lean year and now both of them are gone, and I'm looking at this circle of seven and thinking I don't want to say Roan's name over a cold fire next. You keep those twelve close and you eat first.

speaker: a012
text: Roan, you've got twelve and that's enough to carry you through if you don't give it all away on principle — I've watched you feed others thin before yourself and I'm not watching it again. Fina's right that you eat first. What I want to know from both of you is whether we're moving together to the pile now, before Mako or anyone else decides what's left counts as surplus.

speaker: a010
text: We move together — right now, before that pile gets any lighter. Eron, you take three, Fina takes two, and I'll hold what I have unless the count drops under ten, because twelve food and two blood beside me is more than I've had in a long time and I don't want to be careless with it.

speaker: a012
text: Good — we move now, all three of us, and anyone who asks why we walked to the pile together already knows the answer. Fina, take your two first, then I'll take two or three depending on what's left, and Roan, you watch the count and tell me if Mako's anywhere near that pile before we're done.

speaker: a015
text: Mako's at two food and I don't trust a hungry man with a pile that size — I'll take my two now and I want Eron right behind me, because three of us moving at once makes it harder for anyone to call our count greedy when Mako's reach looks longer than ours. Roan, stay close and keep your eyes on his hands.

speaker: a012
text: Mako's thin and thin men reach fast — I'm taking two now, same as the rule says, and if he's already at the pile before me I want Roan standing where Mako can see him, because your father is the kind of man whose presence alone changes a count. Fina, stay at my shoulder.

speaker: a015
text: Eron, Roan — I'm at the pile now, two food in hand, and Mako hasn't moved yet but he's watching us, so let's not linger where he can count what we carry. What I want to say before we break this circle is that seven is too few and I've been thinking about it since Roan named it last year — I'm twenty-six and I'm not going to let this village shrink to six without at least saying out loud that I'm open to a child if there's a man in this room who isn't kin and has the count to share the cost.

speaker: a010
text: Fina, I heard what you said and I'm glad you said it, because I've been carrying the same weight since Roan named the number last year. Mako's the only man in that circle who isn't kin to you, and he's got two food and a body that could still swing — I'm not saying yes and I'm not saying no for you, but I want you to know what you'd be walking toward before you say it out loud where he can hear it.

speaker: a012
text: Eron takes 2 from the pile (pile now 9).

text: Vela takes 2 from the pile (pile now 7).
